Type.title: Identity document type update value
Type.description: Type of the document (or `null` if the type should not be updated).

Number.title: String update value
Number.description: Number of the document (e.g. passport number or `null` if the number should not be updated).

ExpirationDate.title: String update value
ExpirationDate.description: Expiration date in ISO 8601 format (or `null` if the expiration date should not be updated).

IssuanceDate.title: String update value
IssuanceDate.description: Date of issuance in ISO 8601 format (or `null` if the issuance date should not be updated).

IssuingCountryCode.title: String update value
IssuingCountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 code of the `Country` (or `null` if the issuing country code should not be updated).

IssuingCountrySubdivisionCode.title: String update value
IssuingCountrySubdivisionCode.description: Identifier of the country subdivision where the document was issued (province, state or region) (or `null` if the value should not be updated).

IssuingCity.title: String update value
IssuingCity.description: City where the document was issued (or `null` if the issuing city should not be updated).

IdentityDocumentSupportNumber.title: String update value
IdentityDocumentSupportNumber.description: Identity document support number. Only required for Spanish identity cards in Spanish hotels.
